messages:
maya_support: Heads-up: a customer reported their A/B dashboard shows variant labels rotated after midnight. They flipped rollout_id=219 to 50/50 at 23:58 UTC but the UI shows 80/20 this morning. API assignment logs show 50/50. Ticket #54102.

maya_support: customer says: "looks like the labels swapped around 00:00 UTC, total assignment counts don't line up with /v1/rollouts/219/assignments". They provided screenshots and the exact flip time.

jordan_pm: assigning to analytics. @samir_analytics can you triage scope and quick root-cause hypotheses?

samir_analytics: checking. quick query against rollout_events:
```
SELECT date_trunc('day', event_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') as day_utc, variant_key, count(*)
FROM rollout_events
WHERE rollout_id = 219 AND event_time > now() - interval '48 hours'
GROUP BY 1,2;
```
I see counts that move between variant keys depending on whether we apply date_trunc in UTC or in the org's local tz. Also found surprising diffs when using the streaming assignment hash vs batch aggregator seed.

samir_analytics: preliminary suspicion: two issues 1) deterministic bucketing salt/name drift between the streaming mapper (real-time) and batch aggregator, 2) midnight boundary timezone conversion mismatch for customers in America timezones. Together they manifest as swapped labels + percentage swings at day boundary.

leah_sre: last week we changed naming for the salt var in the streaming job. could be that. Also we recently altered how event_time is normalized in the batch job.

samir_analytics: minimal repro: take the same user_ids and run our streaming hash function vs the batch hash function — ~3% of users end up in a different variant when the salt var differs. Example pseudocode:
```
-- streaming uses rollout.salt
stream_bucket = hash(user_id || salt_stream) % 100
-- batch uses rollout.bucket_seed (old name)
batch_bucket = hash(user_id || bucket_seed) % 100
```

maya_support: customer is org in US/Pacific. they flipped at 23:58 UTC -> 16:58 PDT. but label rotation reported around 00:00 UTC which is 17:00 PDT. they noticed counts shift just after midnight UTC.

jordan_pm: plan: hotfix to align salt names and standardize tz handling, backfill aggregates for impacted rollouts, notify affected customers with credit offer. what's ETA?

samir_analytics: hotfix + unit/regression tests: ~1-2 days. backfill for a single rollout last 7 days: ~2-4 hours cluster time, plus validation. I can prepare migration script:
```
CALL analytics.recalc_rollout_aggregates(rollout_id := 219, start_date := '2026-03-08', end_date := '2026-03-15');
```
We should also persist rollout_salt in control plane and make it immutable so streaming and batch read the same value.

leah_sre: deployment plan:
- push analytics patch to staging, run regression tests
- canary deploy to us-west-2
- run small-window backfill and compare against /v1/rollouts/219/assignments
- if ok, run full window backfill and flip dashboard stale flag
I'll mark dashboards with a "stale-aggregates" badge during backfill.

deploy-bot: Deploy requested by leah_sre for analytics-service @ 1769456952. CI: green. Starting canary.

samir_analytics: added integration test that snapshots hash output for a seeded RNG to catch salt/name drift in CI. PR ready: fixes salt variable, moves bucketing logic to shared lib, adds migration SQL.

leah_sre: canary healthy. kicking off backfill for rollout_id=219 now. monitoring query:
```
SELECT day_utc, variant_key, assignments FROM rollout_aggregates WHERE rollout_id=219 ORDER BY day_utc DESC;
```

leah_sre: backfill completed for target range. sampled users: dashboard percentages now match assignment API. cleared stale badge and sent customer update.

maya_support: customer acknowledged and confirmed counts align. offered a pro-rated credit, they accepted. closing ticket after 24h watch.

jordan_pm: please add a short postmortem in /postmortems: root cause = salt name drift + UTC vs org-tz bucketing edge at midnight. Remediation: canonical rollout_salt, UTC-first bucketization, CI guard, and alerting on large day-over-day cohort deltas.

samir_analytics: will open follow-up tickets for CI guard + control-plane salt persistence. PR merged. Thanks everyone.

leah_sre: nice work. :thumbsup:
